_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no Fed/CPI/NFP/expiry inside 24h, momentum/funding mid, fear mid-30s, so stay on the Anxiety rung until a real range break.
next_move.brains_agree: yes on phase Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative supplies no independent forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, 30d momentum near 50, fear ~30-40, score not shifting ±2 through next windows
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break with fear under ~20 and momentum/funding rolling over, or fear/greed spike plus ETF-flow revival moving score ±2 or more
